doc = FreeCAD.newDocument("PartDesignModel")

# Create a Part Design Body
body = doc.addObject("PartDesign::Body", "Body")

# Create a sketch for the base disk on XY plane (Z=0)
sketch_base = doc.addObject("Sketcher::SketchObject", "Sketch_Base")

circle_geo = Part.Circle()
circle_geo.Center = Base.Vector(0, 0, 0)
circle_geo.Radius = 26
circle_geo.Axis = Base.Vector(0, 0, 1)
sketch_base.addGeometry(circle_geo, False)

# Constrain center to origin using constraints
sketch_base.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint("DistanceX", 0, -1))
sketch_base.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint("DistanceY", 0, -1))

# Set map mode to flat face (XY plane)
sketch_base.MapMode = "FlatFace"

# Create pad for base disk - height 5mm
pad_base = doc.addObject("PartDesign::Pad", "Pad_Base")
pad_base.Profile = sketch_base
pad_base.Length = 5.0  # Use Length instead of Depth
pad_base.Type = 0  # Dimension
pad_base.Reversed = False
pad_base.TaperAngle = 0.0

# Add the pad to the body
body.Group = [pad_base]

# Recompute to get faces
doc.recompute()

# Create a sketch for the boss on the top face of the base (at Z=5)
sketch_boss = doc.addObject("Sketcher::SketchObject", "Sketch_Boss")

boss_circle.Center = Base.Vector(16, 0, 0)
boss_circle.Radius = 3
boss_circle.Axis = Base.Vector(0, 0, 1)

pad_boss.Profile = sketch_boss
pad_boss.Length = 6.0  # Use Length instead of Depth
pad_boss.Type = 0  # Dimension
pad_boss.Reversed = False
pad_boss.TaperAngle = 0.0

doc.recompute()

sketch_base.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint("DistanceY", 0, -1))

pad_base.Reversed = False
pad_base.TaperAngle = 0.0

# Add the pad to the body
body.Group = [pad_base]

# Recompute to get faces
doc.recompute()

# Create a sketch for the boss on the top face of the base (at Z=5)
sketch_boss = doc.addObject("Sketcher::SketchObject", "Sketch_Boss")

# Add circle for boss - radius 3mm, centered at (16, 0)
boss_circle = Part.Circle()
boss_circle.Center = Base.Vector(16, 0, 0)
boss_circle.Radius = 3
boss_circle.Axis = Base.Vector(0, 0, 1)
sketch_boss.addGeometry(boss_circle, False)

# Use AttachmentSupport to attach to the top face
sketch_boss.AttachmentSupport = [(pad_base, ['Face1'])]

# Create pad for boss - height 6mm
pad_boss = doc.addObject("PartDesign::Pad", "Pad_Boss")
pad_boss.Profile = sketch_boss
pad_boss.Length = 6.0  # Use Length instead of Depth
pad_boss.Type = 0  # Dimension
pad_boss.Reversed = False
pad_boss.TaperAngle = 0.0

# Add the boss pad to the body
body.Group = [pad_base, pad_boss]

# Create polar pattern - 8 occurrences, 360 degrees around Z axis
polar_pattern = doc.addObject("PartDesign::PolarPattern", "PolarPattern_Bosses")
print("PolarPattern properties:", [p for p in dir(polar_pattern) if not p.startswith('_')])

# Check Originals property
print("\nTrying to set Originals...")
polar_pattern.Occurrences = 8
polar_pattern.Angle = 360.0
polar_pattern.Axis = (body, "ZAxis")
polar_pattern.Originals = [pad_boss]  # Try Originals instead of Features

# Add the pattern to the body
body.Group = [pad_base, pad_boss, polar_pattern]

# Recompute everything
doc.recompute()

# Save the document
doc.saveAs("/home/user/Unnamed.FCStd")

print("Model created and saved successfully!")
